title: EPA AQS Alameda County hourly PM2.5 2025 snapshot
description: An immutable official-source snapshot of US EPA Air Quality System PM2.5 sample measurements for Alameda County, California, during 2025.
station_selection_protocol: Acquire all predetermined Alameda County PM2.5 monitoring sites, preserve station identifiers, then select one station only in the downstream experiment using an explicit temporal-continuity rule.
quality_control_protocol: Preserve AQS sample duration, method code, qualifier, site identity and source metadata; apply deterministic HeatSafe integrity and quality checks without silently imputing the immutable snapshot.
missing_data_policy: Do not impute or interpolate the immutable raw normalized snapshot. The downstream experiment selects the longest strictly contiguous hourly segment at one monitoring station.
known_limitations: Monitoring-site coverage is not equivalent to population exposure.
Multiple instruments, methods, sample durations and POCs may be present.
The county request can include monitoring sites outside the city of Oakland.
The downstream benchmark is station-level and cannot represent the entire county.
